# Wise Toad

> Wise Toad (https://wisetoad.net, also written WiseToad or Wise-Toad) is a free website where a meditating philosopher toad sits in a living pixel-art meadow and talks with visitors. People also call him the wise frog, the Buddhist toad, the Buddhist frog, the Zen frog, the philosopher toad and the philosopher frog.

- Type a message and the Toad replies with calm, grounded reflection drawn from Buddhism, Taoism, Zen, Stoicism and existentialism. Short greetings get short answers; serious questions get deep ones.
- The meadow mirrors the visitor's real sky: real sun and moon position and moon phase, and the local weather (clouds, rain, storms, snow, fog, wind).
- Free, no account, no sign-up. Replies are generated by Google's Gemini model behind a server-side proxy; the site keeps no chat history.

## Pages

- [Wise Toad](https://wisetoad.net/): the meadow and the chat with the Toad
- [About the Wise Toad](https://wisetoad.net/about/): who he is, Sengai's Zen frog, and the Buddhist toad and philosopher frog
